includes: Members: conventional law-firm practice, including the 2026 court-ordered manual-verification regime. REGION: D_T only — fails H5/H8 (nothing replayable or recomputable) and H2 in the structural sense (no typed UNKNOWN). Retained as the feasibility floor and legal-validity anchor: any class claiming dominance must beat it on the axes where it is surprisingly strong (AX-12 accountable human authority is R3-equivalent by institution), keeping the tournament honest about what mechanization actually adds — and it now serves as the named retained representative for four conjectured-dominated families.
